name: 30-second explainer
description: Topic → script → animated Remotion composition (checkpoint) → rendered MP4. LLM turns only; no priced media steps.

params.label: Topic
params.placeholder: What should the explainer teach, and to whom?

params.label: Style

options.value: Style: Clean — generous whitespace, one accent colour on a light background, calm easing, a clear sans-serif.
options.label: Clean

options.value: Style: Bold — big type, high contrast, dark background, punchy spring animations, one loud accent colour.
options.label: Bold

options.value: Style: Playful — rounded shapes, bright palette, bouncy easing, friendly illustration-like elements.
options.label: Playful

params.default: Style: Clean — generous whitespace, one accent colour on a light background, calm easing, a clear sans-serif.

config.promptPrefix: Write the script for a 30-second explainer video about the topic below. Return ONLY the script: 5 to 7 short on-screen beats, one per line, each a headline (max 8 words) followed by a dash and one supporting sentence. No preamble, no notes.
config.systemPrompt: You write tight, concrete explainer scripts for animated videos. Plain words, active voice, one idea per beat, a memorable closing line.

config.title: Explainer
config.styleNotes: Style: Clean — generous whitespace, one accent colour on a light background, calm easing, a clear sans-serif.
